glossary.bigyeon: Companion is the energy with your own element and polarity. It means independence and peers; too much turns into stubbornness and rivalry.
glossary.geopjae: Rob Wealth shares your element but not your polarity. It brings drive and nerve, but it can also walk off with your money.
glossary.siksin: Eating God is the element you produce, with matching polarity. It means good food, ease and steady self-expression.
glossary.sanggwan: Hurting Officer is the element you produce, with opposite polarity. It brings wit and creativity but clashes with rules.
glossary.pyeonjae: Indirect Wealth is the element you control, with matching polarity. It means windfalls, a wide circle and get-up-and-go.
glossary.jeongjae: Direct Wealth is the element you control, with opposite polarity. It means money earned steadily and careful habits.
glossary.pyeongwan: Seven Killings is the element that controls you, with matching polarity. It means pressure, challenge and the drive to beat it.
glossary.jeonggwan: Direct Officer is the element that controls you, with opposite polarity. It means honor, order and recognition.
glossary.pyeonin: Indirect Resource is the element that feeds you, with matching polarity. It means intuition, unusual ideas and alone time.
glossary.jeongin: Direct Resource is the element that feeds you, with opposite polarity. It means support, learning and paperwork luck.
glossary.combineDay: Harmony pairs two branches that pull together. With your day branch, the seat of you and your partner, people soften.
glossary.combineOther: Harmony pairs two branches that pull together. With your other pillars, the people around you fall in step.
glossary.trine: A half trine is two of the three branches that gather into one element. Strength flows in one direction.
glossary.peach: Peach blossom is the seat of charm and popularity, set by your year and day branches. When today lands on it, you draw eyes.
glossary.clashDay: A clash is two opposite branches colliding. The day branch is the seat of you and your partner, so mood and body wobble.
glossary.clashMonth: A clash is two opposite branches colliding. The month branch is the seat of work and society, so plans slip.
glossary.clashYear: A clash is two opposite branches colliding. The year branch is the seat of family and elders.
glossary.clashHour: A clash is two opposite branches colliding. The hour branch governs results and your body’s rhythm.
glossary.wonjin: Wonjin and harm pair branches that resent each other. They invite small hurts and misunderstandings.
glossary.punish: Punishment is branches wounding each other. It warns of friction, fatigue and small accidents.
glossary.stemCombine: A stem union draws two stems into one. When today’s stem unites with your day stem, attraction and connection appear.
glossary.stemClash: A stem clash is two stems colliding head-on. When today’s stem strikes your day stem, energy drains.
glossary.favorable: Your helpful element is the one your chart needs most for balance. Days rich in it run smoothly.
glossary.unfavorable: Your draining element is the one your chart already has too much of. Days heavy with it take more effort.

bigyeon: Today brings Companion energy, the same element as you. Your colors get bolder, and so do collisions. Perfect for pushing something solo.
It’s the energy of a friend standing shoulder to shoulder. Team up and you feel backed; dig in your heels and it gets tiring.
geopjae: Rob Wealth is the energy of a rival eyeing your share. Your drive wakes up, but money and chances leak easily, so lock the doors first.
Your nerve grows today. Challenges are fine, but look twice at shared money: co-signing, partnerships, big payments.
siksin: Eating God is the energy of good food and ease. Your heart loosens and things flow out of your hands. Do what you love and luck follows.
Words and work come out easily today. A tasty meal is your lucky charm.
sanggwan: Hurting Officer is the energy of rule-breaking wit. Ideas sparkle, but words get sharp. Take a beat before speaking to anyone above you.
Your expressiveness peaks. Wings for pitches, writing and planning; poison for group-chat arguments.
pyeonjae: Indirect Wealth is the energy of rolling-in money and a wide circle. The more people you meet, the more chances stick, and the faster cash leaves.
You see the bigger board today. Sleep on investment calls; book the meetups right away.
jeongjae: Direct Wealth is the energy of money earned by sweat. Planning beats gambling, and settling up beats jackpots.
Carefulness gets rewarded as is. Paperwork, budgets and tidy shopping carts attract luck today.
pyeongwan: Seven Killings is the energy of pressure that forges you. Hold out and it becomes skill; overdo it and your body notices first.
Responsibility gets heavier, but so does your presence. Strong for deadlines and showdowns, weak for self-care.
jeonggwan: Direct Officer is the energy of order and recognition. Keeping rules and promises turns straight into reputation.
A good day to catch the boss’s eye. Neat beats flashy.
pyeonin: Indirect Resource is the energy of unusual intuition. Your radar sharpens, but thoughts chase their own tails. Jot them down; they’re treasure.
Alone time recharges you today. Dig into something unfamiliar and a surprising answer appears.
jeongin: Direct Resource is the energy that looks after you. Help, good news and chances to learn come to you first.
A day of receiving. Say thank you freely and the luck doubles.

loves.name: The LOVES game

strokes: · the majority of 19 Korean name-match calculators. Double consonants count twice; clusters add up their parts.
loves: · a playground classic. Count L, O, V, E and S in both names, then keep adding neighbours. A sum of 10 or more splits into two digits (12 → 1, 2).
rules.common: The same two names always give the same result. No dates, no dice, and the names never leave this screen.

fortune.title: Star walk
fortune.text: Your six saju characters walk from today's star and draw a constellation

random.title: Just draw
random.text: Six numbers drawn evenly from 1–45. Only your keep and skip picks apply

intro: · A method made by Unbbal Day, built from classic saju pieces: the 60-day cycle, Hado numbers, the generating and controlling cycles, and the harmful element.
items: The 45 stars link into one path in number order (45 loops back to 1). Each star's element comes from its last digit by the Hado numbers: 1·6 Water, 2·7 Fire, 3·8 Wood, 4·9 Metal, 5·0 Earth.
The walk starts at the star matching today's place in the 60-day cycle. If your birth hour is known, its two characters first move the starting point.

Each of the six year, month and day characters takes one walk, and the star it lands on becomes a number. Steps = the character's number (stems 1–10, branches 1–12) plus the matching character of today.
If the current star's element and the character's element control each other, the walk goes toward smaller numbers; otherwise toward larger ones.
Landing on a clouded star of the harmful element, or on one already lit, moves one star further.
rules.outro: The same birthday on the same day always draws the same constellation. Every number has the same odds.
